notes: Strip x 0-1970, full height. Names: Highland, Harper, Norwood, Harris, Park and Kenilworth are printed without suffix in this strip; 'Avenue' added to match the 82A picks. Robertson printed without suffix, left as 'Robertson'. Smith printed 'SMIT...' (cut). The long N-S avenue at x ~1771 (Highland to Harris) is printed only 'AVENUE'; it continues, narrowed, SSW across the railroads and becomes the street printed 'FOREST' (x ~1590) from the Allis-Chalmers works to Robertson; taken as one street 'Forest Avenue' (split label) - unconfirmed. Ash Street and Pine Street read ASH/ST. and PINE/ST. Big diagonal letters across the blocks (WILBER, ARNOLD SUB., etc.) are subdivision names, not streets. Not streets: the streetcar loop around block 13, the railroad strip with an 18 in. sewer running ESE from Forest Avenue at y ~3420, the tracks along y ~3995, the streetcar/spur curve at Forest/y ~4385, the blue and orange boundary bands.
